settings.aiServicesDesc: API Keys are your private assets. To reduce leakage risk, this software encrypts and saves them in the local backend database; however, absolute security cannot be guaranteed in extreme cases such as computer compromise.
settings.getFromConsole: Get one from the official console →
settings.securityAgreement.title: API Key Security Agreement
settings.securityAgreement.readAndAgree: I have read, understood, and agree to the above security terms
settings.securityAgreement.intro: Please read the following security notice carefully before configuring and using API Keys:
settings.securityAgreement.conclusion: By clicking "Agree", you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to the above terms.
settings.securityAgreement.items.storage: Your API Keys will be encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption and stored in the local database. The encryption key is derived from your device information and will never be uploaded to any server.
settings.securityAgreement.items.risk.de: Although we use industry-standard encryption measures, absolute security cannot be guaranteed in extreme cases such as device compromise or operating system breaches.
settings.securityAgreement.items.permiss: Please keep your API Keys secure and do not share them with others. We recommend setting usage limits in each provider's console to avoid unexpected charges.
settings.securityAgreement.items.transmi: This software only sends requests directly to official API endpoints when calling AI services, and will never forward your keys to any third-party servers.
settings.securityAgreement.items.disclai: Users are responsible for any losses caused by key leakage, theft, or account anomalies. This software does not collect, upload, or store your keys in the cloud.
settings.clearCredentialsWarning: This will clear encrypted DeepSeek / Gemini / ByteDance Ark / Meshy / GitHub / Anthropic API credentials stored in the local backend database. Related AI features will be unavailable until you re-save your keys.
